instructions: Drain the tofu and press it dry between a few paper towels. Drain and rinse the black beans.

Put the beans in a small saucepan with 2 tbsp water and 1/4 tsp of the salt. Warm them over medium-low heat for 4 minutes, mashing a few with a spoon so they thicken a little. Keep them on the lowest heat.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Crumble in the tofu with your hands and cook for 3 minutes, stirring only now and then, until the edges start to turn golden.
Sprinkle over the turmeric, garlic powder, the remaining 1/2 tsp salt and the pepper. Stir for 1 minute, until it smells toasty and the tofu is evenly yellow.
Add 2 tbsp water and cook for 2 minutes, until the pan is dry. Transfer the scramble to a bowl.
Wipe out the skillet and heat it over medium-high. Warm the tortillas one at a time for 30 seconds on each side, until soft with a few brown spots. Stack them in a clean towel as you go.
Meanwhile, slice the avocado and chop the cilantro.
Fill each tortilla with a spoonful of beans and some of the scramble. Top with the avocado, salsa and cilantro.
method_notes: No source has 20 ratings, so this is a fallback. Running on Real Food (5 from 1 vote) is the lead: crumbled tofu with turmeric, garlic powder and a little water, in tortillas with beans, avocado and salsa. Blissful Basil (5 from 3 votes, gluten-free and vegan) cooks the tofu in a spiced tomato base, and Glue and Glitter sautes it in oil first, which is why the tofu is browned in oil here. Corn tortillas keep it gluten-free; the Glue and Glitter soy sauce is left out.
